content:
**Ally: Stalking Stuffer** is an ally quest for Beckett in *Fallout 76*, introduced in the *Wastelanders* update.

Beckett will ask the player character to retrieve a weapon case from a marked location. Returning the weapon case rewards the player character with a random legendary weapon of up to 3-star quality.

It is possible to find the weapon case to retrieve before the quest is given by Beckett. This will automatically start the quest, skipping to the "Bring Weapon Case to Beckett" quest stage.
